quote.text: Fikir means love in Amharic. It was born after living in Ethiopia and Kenya, so that the coffee we drink here helps those who grow it there.

impact.statement: Fikir Social Café reinvests 100% of its annual net profit in social projects in the countries of origin.
impact.ethiopia: When you choose a coffee from Ethiopia, you support social projects in Ethiopia.
impact.kenya: When you choose a coffee from Kenya, you support social projects in Kenya.
impact.uganda: When you choose a coffee from Uganda, you support social projects in Uganda.

how.heading: The profit goes back to where the coffee grows
how.text:
Fikir Social Café is a company with a clear purpose: 100% of its annual net profit goes to social projects in Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda.

The money goes to the country of the coffee you buy. If you choose Kenya, you support projects in Kenya.
how.image_alt: Women from an East African community in traditional dress

steps.heading: What happens with every purchase
steps.step1_title: We pay for the coffee and the costs
steps.step1_text: Green coffee, roasting, packaging, shipping and company expenses.
steps.step2_text: At the end of each year, from the company accounts.
steps.step3_text: 100% goes to social projects in the countries our coffees come from. We'll share here which ones we support.

origin.heading: Coffees with a name and a place
origin.text: We work with lots from smallholder farmers and cooperatives in Sidamo (Ethiopia), Nyeri (Kenya) and Rubirizi and Kasese (Uganda). Each coffee page tells you the region, altitude, variety and process.
origin.image_alt: Farmers picking coffee on an East African plantation

story.heading: Fikir means love
story.text:
In Amharic, the language of Ethiopia. Fikir didn't start as a business. It started after living in Kenya and Ethiopia and working for two years at an orphanage in Meki.

A simple idea came back from there: that the coffee we drink every day should help the communities that grow it. That's why the net profit goes back to the countries of origin.
story.image_alt: Pablo Esteve Rozas, founder of Fikir, in Meki (Ethiopia)

roast.heading: Specialty, medium roast and small batches
roast.text: We select specialty coffees from smallholder farmers and give them a medium roast, so the origin comes through. Every bag shows its roast date and batch.
roast.image_alt: Coffee beans roasting in a drum with steam

values.heading: Three principles
values.step1_text: We tell you where each coffee comes from and who grows it before we talk about tasting notes.
values.step2_text: We say what we do with the profit and in which countries. No superlatives.
values.step3_text: Impact doesn't excuse bad coffee. We choose each lot for how it tastes.

b2b.heading: Coffee with impact for your company

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Grind, shipping, subscription and impact. If you can't find your answer, write to us.

home.heading: What people ask us most
home.a1: Whole beans keep their aroma best; if you have a grinder, that's the way to go. If not, choose your brewer's grind and we'll grind it before shipping.
home.a2: Espresso for espresso or bean-to-cup machines. Moka pot for stovetop. Filter / V60 for drip, Chemex or V60. French press / Cold brew for plunger and cold brew.
home.q3: How long does shipping take and how much is it?
home.a3: We ship with SEUR to mainland Spain in 3-5 working days. It costs €5.90 and it's free from €50. For now we don't ship to the Balearic or Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla.
home.q4: How should I store the coffee?
home.a4: In its bag, tightly closed, away from light and heat. Never in the fridge. Ideally, drink it within 6 weeks of roasting.
home.a5: When you buy two or more bags, in any combination of origins and sizes, a 5% discount is applied automatically in the cart.
home.a6: Fikir Social Café reinvests 100% of its annual net profit in social projects in Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda, in each coffee's country.

full.heading: Everything you need to know
full.a1: Whole beans keep their aroma best; if you have a grinder, that's the way to go. If not, choose your brewer's grind and we'll grind it before shipping.
full.a2: Espresso for espresso or bean-to-cup machines. Moka pot for stovetop. Filter / V60 for drip, Chemex or V60. French press / Cold brew for plunger and cold brew.
full.q3: How long does shipping take and how much is it?
full.a3: We ship with SEUR to mainland Spain in 3-5 working days. It costs €5.90 and it's free from €50.
full.q4: Do you ship to the islands or outside Spain?
full.a4: For now we only ship to mainland Spain. If you're elsewhere, write to us and we'll let you know when we expand.
full.q5: How should I store the coffee?
full.a5: In its bag, tightly closed, away from light and heat. Never in the fridge. Ideally, drink it within 6 weeks of roasting.
full.q6: How long does a bag last?
full.a6: 250 g makes about 15-17 espressos or 12-14 filter cups. A 1 kg bag makes about 60 cups.
full.a7: You get two 250 g bags as often as you choose, shipping included. Pick one origin or get a different one each time, and pause or cancel from your account.
full.a8: When you buy two or more bags, in any combination, a 5% discount is applied automatically in the cart.
full.a9: As it's a food product, we can't accept returns of opened coffee. If your order arrives damaged or wrong, write to us within 14 days and we'll sort it out.
full.a10: Fikir Social Café reinvests 100% of its annual net profit in social projects in Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda, in each coffee's country.

impact.heading: Questions about our impact
impact.a1: What's left after paying for the coffee, roasting, packaging, shipping, taxes and company expenses.
impact.q2: Which country does my purchase support?
impact.a2: The origin country of the coffee you choose. Packs, the rotating subscription and 1 kg bags are shared among the countries of origin.
impact.q3: How do I know it happens?
impact.a3: We'll publish on this page the projects we support each year and the amount allocated.
impact.a4: Yes. Write to us from the contact page and we'll consider it.
